entrypoints.description: ArchivedEvidenceRecorder owns fail-closed locator/value verification against preserved source-derived artifacts.

extension_seams: Add a generic parser/artifact grounding mode when a new media type cannot be truthfully represented by existing locators.

Use a truthful source-derived readable representation when claim-relevant PDF content was actually read but raw PDF bytes are pending; preserve the upstream PDF identity/media type separately and never call the representation byte-identical PDF.
Add claim_context annotations without silently promoting them into Reality/Judgment.

guards.description: Grounding tests exercise archived excerpt/artifact boundaries.
Handoff regression keeps locator existence below claim-level Evidence while allowing content-verified readable representations to proceed.

non_goals: Promoting a PDF locator whose claim-relevant content was never read.
Pretending a text/visible capture is raw PDF bytes or erasing representation provenance.
Media-type shortcuts that lose exact locator/content integrity.
purpose: Own verification that a claim-scoped EvidenceFragment is exactly grounded in preserved source-derived content before epistemic promotion. Grounding may use archived raw PDF/HTML/JSON or a truthful readable representation of content the Agent actually read; locator existence alone is never claim Evidence.
revisit_when: Only replace if the successor preserves claim-scoped immutable artifact lineage, exact locator semantics, truthful media/representation provenance and fail-closed verification across supported media.
title: Claim-scoped Grounded Evidence
